answer_1.quote: ISNI excels across all evaluated tasks, markedly improving the BLEU score by 2-3 times for Response Generation (RG).

answer_2.quote: Precision (P) and Recall (R), F1 is used to evaluate KTD. Mean Reciprocal Rank at 5 (MRR@5) and Recall at 1, 5 (R@1,5) are used to evaluate KS. To evaluate RG, Bleu at 1,2,3,4 (B@1,2,3,4) and Meteor (M) and Rouge at 1,2,L (RG@1,2,L) are used.
